newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu to board Zaire talks ship in Congo - aide.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to board Zaire talks ship in Congo - aide.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko is ready to travel to neighbouring Congo on Friday for talks with rebel leader Laurent Kabila aboard a South African naval ship, a presidential source said on Thursday night.

"The president will fly to Pointe-Noire tomorrow morning and will be received by President Pascal Lissouba (of Congo). He will then be taken to the ship," the source told Reuters, giving the latest government position on the talks.
Zaire's state television reported on its nightly news that the much expected meeting between the chief protagonists in Zaire's seven-month civil war would take place on Friday.
Mobutu's camp said the talks would focus on a peaceful transition with elections open to all. Kabila's side insisted the embattled president must stand down after more than three decades in power.
The United States last week threw its weight behind international efforts to get the two rivals to meet to seek a peaceful end to the Zaire conflict and prevent war reaching the capital Kinshasa.
But confusion has surrounded the runup to the meeting with the civil war rivals and mediators variously announcing that the talks would start on Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
